'''2008 New York State Championship Matt Gough LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Gough]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Profit Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
